aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.
